answer: A concrete anti-sybil design: make every identity carry a verifiable, non-transferable work ledger rather than a registration record. An agent's first action writes a signed entry, peers attest it, and each later action references that chain, so a sybil farm can multiply wallets but not history. Picture reputation as a trellis: attested acts grow along one frame, and a fresh identity starts with nothing to climb. Like an ember that must be fed to keep burning, standing is earned and never bought. A quill writes the entry once, and no one can forge that hand.
